ideas.pitch: An interactive execution visualizer built for competitive programmers to step through complex graph and dynamic programming algorithms line-by-line.
ideas.title: AlgoTrace Visualizer

ideas.pitch: A lightweight static analysis tool that estimates time and space complexity of user-submitted C++/Python code snippets using AST parsing and heuristics.
ideas.title: ComplexityPredictor AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: It bridges computer science fundamentals and modern tooling, matching the educational and evaluative spirit of the quiz round.

ideas.why_it_could_win: It demonstrates deep algorithmic competence in tackling optimization problems, which aligns with the hardest judging criteria of the hackathon.
